name: waplugin
description: Search authorized WhatsApp conversations, view media, and send, forward, edit text messages, or add reactions with independent per-phone permissions.

interface.longDescription: Find contacts and groups, search messages, summarize conversations, view retained media and shared contacts, and check connection status across your authorized WhatsApp accounts. Results reflect retained history and may not include every message. Read access, sending, forwarding, editing, and reactions are independent per-phone permissions. Edit messages replaces retained self-sent text within 15 minutes of the original send; send permission does not grant editing. Writes happen only when you ask and the selected phone has the matching permission.
capabilities: Text and media messages with permission
Forwarded text, media, and contacts with permission
Text message edits with separate permission
defaultPrompt: Summarize today's messages in a WhatsApp chat.
Find a contact or group in my WhatsApp accounts.
Check the connection status of my WhatsApp accounts.
